[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 19:03  
[USER] User requests API documentation for generating a wallet.  
[USER] To receive a token, a wallet has to be generated.  
[USER] The endpoint is POST /account/wallet.  
[USER] The parameters are token, coin, and network.  
[USER] Example parameters: token: user token to access the API, coin: BTC, network: BTC.  
[USER] Responses are: address, memo, and network, coin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] API Documentation: Generate Wallet Endpoint  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Endpoint: POST /account/wallet  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Description: This endpoint generates a wallet for a user with the specified coin and network. A wallet address and memo will be returned upon successful creation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Request Parameters:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * token (required): User token to access the API.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * coin (required): The cryptocurrency to generate the wallet for. Supported coins: BTC, ETH, LTC.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] * network (required): The network to generate the wallet for. Supported networks: BTC, ETH, LTC.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example Request:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ```bash  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] POST /account/wallet  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] {  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9",  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "coin": "BTC",  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "network": "BTC"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] }  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example Response:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ```css  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] HTTP/1.1 200 OK  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] {  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "address": "1BvBMSEYstWetqTFn5Au4m4GFg7xJaNVN2",  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "memo": "abc123",  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "network": "BTC",  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "coin": "BTC"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] }  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ```
